formulas.delta_utility_pct: ((U_belief - U_no_belief) / U_no_belief) * 100, where U_belief=belief_on_quantile utility mean and U_no_belief=belief_off utility mean
formulas.delta_completion_abs: CR_belief - CR_no_belief, where CR_belief=belief_on_quantile completion mean and CR_no_belief=belief_off completion mean
